title: Wisdom extractor output v0 — one response per SEGMENT
description: Contract between S-D (extractor), S-E (eval/outcomes), S-F (review/publish). The model returns ONLY what the text supports; offsets are computed server-side by locating `quote` in the normalised segment text (tools/wisdom_golden_verify.py normalisation). A record whose quote is not found exactly once is rejected and counted, never kept. Levels are AS STATED (R5): never inferred from bars. Private fields (size_shares, and entry on an open position) are split into the owner-private store by the writer, never by the model.

quote.description: Verbatim substring of the segment text (speaker prefixes excluded), minimal but sufficient.

speaker_label.description: Raw speaker label as it appears (Zoom cue prefix / Discord author display name / Sunday Scans section owner). Normalised to an author server-side via authors.json.

ticker_as_heard.description: For transcripts: the word as transcribed when it is not a clean symbol (e.g. 'light' for LITE).

setup_vocab.description: MUST be an exact name from the vocabulary list supplied in the prompt, or null. Unknown names stay in setup_name_raw and become vocabulary candidates.

trigger.description: Observable trigger event as stated (R1b), e.g. 'gap down then red to green'.

stop_text.description: Stop as worded when relative ('yesterday's low', 'breakeven').

price_as_heard.description: Raw spoken/written form when it differs (e.g. '9.30' for 930); normalised server-side by the price-sanity pass.

size_shares.description: OWNER-PRIVATE. Routed to the private store by the writer; never returned by any member-facing module.

confidence_language.description: Verbatim phrases; never averaged into a score.

event_at_text.description: Relative time as worded ('Friday', 'this week'); resolved server-side against the source publish/recording time.

hindsight.description: True for teaching/retrospective examples (R4, D8): excluded from UCT-see rate.

statement.description: Near-verbatim restatement in the author's own terms.

testable_claim.description: D15: the factual claim in testable form, or null.
